title: Former Testimony of Unavailable Witness

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: The testimony that ______ <insert name of witness> has given under oath (was/will be) (read to/played for) you because (he/she) is not available. You must evaluate this testimony by the same standards that you apply to a witness who testified here in court.

bench_notes.text: The court has discretion to give an instruction on the weight a jury should give to former testimony of an unavailable witness. (*People v. Wharton* (1991) 53 Cal.3d 522, 598–599 [280 Cal.Rptr. 631, 809 P.2d 290].) No case holds that a trial court has a sua sponte duty to instruct on the use of former testimony of an unavailable witness.
